items.name: 雨中归城
items.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. ONE fully finished Chinese visual-novel publicity poster, portrait 9:16, best supported native portrait resolution, preferably 1440x2560. The user asks for THREE more options with CLEARLY DIFFERENT MAIN SCENES. This poster must depict its specified new location, not the old riverside bridge, river-view alley, portrait montage or internet-cafe counter. Retain the previous posters' premium detailed painterly realism, giant beautifully designed Chinese Song type, emotionally grounded adult small-city life, elegant gold/ivory support typography and readable visual hierarchy. This is a NEW composition, not a text swap or retint of the style reference. 6% safe margins and polished simplified Chinese. The environment should dominate; avoid a giant cropped head over a tiny location. No poster frame, collage panels, QR, URL, invented date, platform logo, credits or watermark. No fake publication claims. Copy version exactly as v1.1 新版预告 and include 开发中.
Exact shared text:
small top kicker “互动视觉小说”
huge main title in two lines “毕节，” / “雨停之前”
prominent lower version line “v1.1 新版预告”
footer “六条路线 · 十四种结局 · 双后日谈”
small footer status “开发中”.
Only add the one specified tagline for this option. No additional text or readable signage, timetables, prices or brand labels.

Primary request: 方案D“雨中归城”。Bright, misty, blue-gray early-day rain at a small-city ARRIVAL PLATFORM / sheltered transport-station passage in Bijie, Guizhou. The MAIN VISUAL is an extraordinary deep-perspective rainy platform roof: dark steel columns and receding roof beams, long wet tiled floor and yellow tactile strip, ordinary metal bench, rain curtains beyond the shelter, soft misty green hills and modest houses distant. This scene is about arriving home with one's ordinary luggage. No river, arched bridge, nighttime neon, cafes, train, rails, bus or specific transport mode. No giant skyline.
Input roles: image 1 is typography quality / illustrated realism STYLE reference ONLY, not its setting or color. Image 2 is the true NEW ENVIRONMENT reference and must dominate the design. Image 3 is the current protagonist identity: 文文, 23-year-old adult with broad round face, black eyebrows, GOLDEN BLOND SHORT BUZZ CUT, faded LIGHT BLUE DENIM JACKET with turned cuffs over IVORY tee, charcoal straight trousers and black canvas shoes. Keep his recognizable face and build if face visible. Do not use black hair or a dark repair jacket.
Composition: fresh cinematic wide-angle view transformed into portrait. Overhead roof lines lead through the image, a lone recognizable protagonist in 3/4 rear view at lower right or center-right, human scale occupying only about one third of image height, holding a plain modest worn suitcase by his side, gaze toward the rain and exit. The suitcase belongs to the opening arrival; no invented readable label or luxury brand. No other featured characters, no couple, no glamour pose. His head should NOT become a giant foreground portrait. Large pearl-white Song title positioned in the dark upper roof area, tagline beneath, open misty silver-blue center, naturally dark lower foreground for high-contrast version and footer. Subtle warm shelter fluorescent glow, quiet fresh daylight, wet-floor reflection, painterly film still; NOT sunset, NOT the previous teal/orange nightclub look.
One additional exact tagline: “回到毕节，重新出发。”
The image must immediately read as rainy arrival station, visually distinct from a bridge or city alley.

Primary request: 方案E“街角烟火”。A close, lively, lived-in NIGHT BARBECUE STALL under a red-orange rain canopy on a modest Bijie neighborhood street. Rich vermilion, amber tungsten bulbs, ember glow, grilling smoke and tasty ordinary skewers; rain drips from awning beyond; small plastic stools and simple stainless-steel table. The main scene is this intimate street food stall, NOT a panorama: do not show ANY river, arched bridge, monumental skyline or cafe monitors. Frame close enough that the grill, canopy and table dominate. No fancy restaurant, wine bar, luxury food or excessive party decoration.
Input roles: image 1 is illustrative polish and title quality STYLE ONLY; do not reuse its bridge, sky or montage. Image 2 is actual NEW ENVIRONMENT and materials; crop/redesign to focus on the stall, OMIT its distant river/bridge. Images 3 and 4 are the two current adult character identities, overriding any old figure design. Image 3 文文: GOLDEN BLOND SHORT BUZZ CUT, round broad face, black eyebrows, faded LIGHT BLUE DENIM JACKET over IVORY tee with turned cuffs, same recognizable facial identity. Image 4 罗小满: adult woman, same recognizable face, shoulder-length pale-golden hair, BRICK-RED DOUBLE-STRIPE JACKET, plain white inner tee. Preserve age and natural shapes; do not generic-beautify either into idols.
Composition: two people seated across or diagonally at a modest low table, conversational, relaxed friendly expressions, natural elbow and hand anatomy, no touching, embrace or established-romance pose; this is promotional daily-life imagery rather than a new canon event. Show them medium-sized with readable faces; don't fill image with a giant portrait. Foreground skewers and grill steam, midground two characters/table, canopy and bulbs above. Small street beyond stays soft and unfeatured. Large ivory Song title lives in naturally dark red-brown canopy space in top 27%, tagline in warm cream; lower foreground table/embers fade naturally into dark version text band. Lush warm cinematic color, social warmth, grounded painterly realism, energetic compared with the solitary gray station and quiet closed door.
One additional exact tagline: “一桌烟火，几段未完的关系。”
No additional customers with readable faces or invented uniforms; no money notes, bill totals, alcohol branding, romantic finale or tragedy cues. Fully readable footer.

Primary request: 方案F“门后三拍”。An exquisitely composed STILL-LIFE / ARCHITECTURAL night poster centered on the ordinary OLD WOODEN BACKYARD DOOR behind a small-city internet cafe. Close view of weathered off-white plaster, dark damp timber, a simple warm yellow wall lamp above, a NARROW door crack with soft indoor light spilling diagonally onto wet stone ground, a modest blue plastic stool corner, small potted white flowers and a plain mop leaning against wall. Deep desaturated jade/indigo, slate-gray walls, restrained amber highlights. The doorway is a mundane domestic threshold, NOT a magical glowing portal.
Input roles: image 1 is exact Song typography quality, elegant quiet breathing room and painterly pigment detail STYLE reference ONLY, NOT its river/bridge/umbrella setting or ivory paper layout. Image 2 is the actual NEW ENVIRONMENT reference and must determine the door, light, plaster and ordinary life textures. Do not include river, bridge, alley vista, mountains, umbrella, city skyline or cafe-counter monitors. No people, human silhouettes, hands, faces, humanoids or human-form hidden character. Do not show the yellow sphere either: the character remains unseen beyond the door. This is anticipation and gentle curiosity, not horror or crime.
Composition: graphic, intimate, large doorway as the visual anchor occupying center/right lower 65%, the line of light leads from the crack down and toward viewer; old wall with soft night shadow gives natural negative space for a very large ivory Song title upper left, tagline below it, dark wet floor supports refined gold/ivory version and footer. Beautiful material texture, raindrops on stone and lamp glow. Warm humane feeling, unhurried silence; entirely different scale and geometry from the open station or busy stall. Single seamless full-bleed illustration, not paper-photo collage. Do not make it excessively black so door details disappear.
One additional exact tagline: “有些相遇，从三下轻响开始。”
All shared version/footer text exact and readable. No scary red light, ghost, occult marks, locks or threatening shadow. Do not add new plot facts, dates, handwriting or names on door.
